requirements_summary: Enterprise FS firm needs Private VPC deployment in EU region with customer-managed KMS, audit logs shipped to their SIEM, SSO/SAML enforcement, and explicit data residency (EU-only). Workloads: embeddings + reranking in low-latency path; chat assistant with <150ms p50 target for short prompts, 250-300ms p95; throughput target 100 qps steady with 300 qps burst window. Must support canary model rollouts and offline evals before production swap.
architecture_fit: Preferred topology: Redwood Private control plane in a Redwood-managed region with a tenant connector deployed inside NorthBridge's VPC. Two supported patterns discussed: (1) Egress-only model where connector initiates outbound TLS to Redwood control plane endpoints over 443 (recommended for strict inbound policies) using AWS VPC endpoints/PrivateLink or GCP Private Service Connect; (2) PrivateLink/Endpoint approach with inbound VPC endpoint for management + data plane traffic kept inside customer network. Suggested network design: two private subnets for inference nodes, NAT gateway for outbound (if egress pattern used) with restricted CIDR allowlist; an internal ALB in front of connector only if NorthBridge needs traffic shaping. KMS flow: model artifacts + token caches encrypted at rest with SSE-KMS using customer CMKs (BYOK); Redwood runtime supports KMS envelope encryption and HSM-backed keys for key rotation audits. Audit logging: realtime token-level and request/response metadata (redacted) exported to customer's S3 bucket or Log Forwarder into Splunk/Elastic via Kinesis/Logging sink; retention controls configurable by route. Regions: primary target eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) or eu-west-1 (Ireland); client preference eu-central-1 for data residency. Ports: outbound to Redwood control plane 443; optional outbound to S3 endpoints for artifact sync; minimal inbound—only private endpoints if using PrivateLink. Bandwidth/cost notes: model pulls and checkpoint syncs can be scheduled to reduce egress; caching layer reduces repeated downloads. Operational notes: require an initial architecture review call with their infra (VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect if using hybrid), produce network diagram and a list of CIDRs for security team, and demo of KMS key wrap/unwrap flow in their account.
